content: Idiomatic SQLAlchemy claim-guard pattern: build a Core update() with WHERE id=X AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < now), SET locked_until=<new lease>; execute via db.session.execute(); commit; check result.rowcount == 1 to determine whether this process won the claim. This is portable across Postgres and SQLite since it relies only on UPDATE's row-match semantics, not dialect-specific locking clauses (no SELECT...FOR UPDATE needed).
